For every integer r>=1, the maximal dyadic denominator exponent of the literal kappa_r(u,v) is 2r+v2((r-1)!). Every coefficient satisfies the upper bound and the nonzero pure-u^r coefficient attains it. Odd denominator factors are allowed.
